name: @timmyjl12/pi-todo
description: Persistent, visible todo tracking for the pi coding agent — Claude Code-style task tools (TaskCreate/TaskGet/TaskList/TaskUpdate) with dependency edges, an above-editor widget, a statusline pill, and a /todo menu overlay.
